requested_by: Omri 2026-09-29: find a principled way to integrate step position as an additional channel (the external check, Step 459, showed that the step index alone beats every method on Hard2Verify and Socratic). No report yet.
principle: Error propagation: a step that follows an error builds on it, so the probability that a step is erroneous tends to rise along the answer. This is a structural prior of multi-step reasoning, not a label-derived quantity. The position channel is therefore added like any other channel and the EXISTING label-free machinery decides whether and how much it counts: the Dawid-Skene filter estimates its accuracy from its agreement with the other channels (keep iff pi_hat > 0.5), and in the grouped method it is its own group whose weight comes from the group-level Dawid-Skene estimate. No weight, sign or threshold for position is set by hand or from labels.
task_conflict_declared: Rewarding later steps helps the step-validity task (PRMBench within-answer AUC and PRMScore; Socratic; Hard2Verify) but is expected to HURT first-error localization (ProcessBench: the argmax moves toward the end). ProcessBench is reported beside every arm; a decision in favour of a position channel must state this trade-off.

channels.POS: relative step index within the answer (0 .. n-1), answer-z-scored (constant 0 for one-step answers); its top-20% marks are the last ceil(0.2 n) steps
channels.CUM: accumulated evidence: running mean over steps 1..t of the answer-z plain-average score of the DS survivors (BASE), answer-z-scored; uses the answer's own signal instead of a fixed prior; computed after the DS filter

banks: B16, B23, B35, B54 (the four digit banks, as in the external test); construction as results/algorithm_decisions_v1 (partition_switch_run.py bank(), replays P0__BASE exactly)

arms_per_bank.BASE: DS filter, plain average (= algorithm_decisions_v1 P0__BASE; replay hard stop 1e-9)
arms_per_bank.BASE_POS: DS filter on the bank plus POS (one Dawid-Skene fit on all channels' marks + POS marks; POS key drawn separately so the other channels' marks are unchanged), plain average of all survivors (POS enters with weight 1/p if kept)
arms_per_bank.BASE_CUM: DS filter as BASE; then one Dawid-Skene fit on the survivors' marks + CUM marks; plain average of the survivors that stay above 0.5 plus CUM if kept
arms_per_bank.GRP: DS filter, binary partition + merge, mean within groups, DS-estimate MLE weights between groups (= algorithm_decisions_v1 P0__EQ_DSM; replay hard stop 1e-9)
arms_per_bank.GRP_POS: GRP with POS added as its own group (group-level Dawid-Skene on the group marks + POS marks, POS key drawn separately); MLE weights
arms_per_bank.GRP_CUM: GRP with CUM added as its own group

folds_and_access: as algorithm_decisions_v1: eval fold k, calibration (k+1)%5 for the PRMScore threshold only, learning on the other three (DS on PRMBench learning steps, partition on all learning steps); write-once; no fallback
endpoints: PRMBench within-answer AUC (primary), official PRMScore; ProcessBench gate-free SLA macro-8 (beside, expected to worsen)

contrasts.primary: per bank: BASE_POS - BASE and GRP_POS - GRP on PRMBench within-AUC; 2 x 4 = 8, Bonferroni, paired source-group bootstrap 50,000 draws (seed 20260927)
contrasts.secondary: per bank at 95%: BASE_CUM - BASE, GRP_CUM - GRP, GRP_POS - BASE, POS_ALONE - BASE; the same contrasts on PRMScore and ProcessBench SLA

nulls: for every primary contrast: same-length whole-answer label swap and within-answer shuffle (200 permutations, seeds 12 / 11); the content share (observed minus swap mean) is reported beside every gain, because a position channel is expected to gain mainly through position

interpretation_frozen.adopt_position_channel: a variant is recommended for the method only if its primary contrast is Bonferroni above 0 on within-AUC on all four banks AND its content share (observed minus swap mean) is above 0 on at least 3 of 4 banks; otherwise it is reported as a positional prior, not a method gain
interpretation_frozen.processbench: the ProcessBench SLA change is reported beside and must be stated in any recommendation

then: if a variant is recommended, a separate frozen external check (exploratory; the benchmarks are exposed) with the step-index row, swap nulls and equal-share comparisons (LESSONS 2026-09-29)

predictions_frozen.P1: the DS filter keeps POS on every bank and fold (it agrees with the error-prone late steps other channels mark)
predictions_frozen.P2: BASE_POS - BASE is small on development (< 0.005 within-AUC) because the step index alone is weak there (0.6617)
predictions_frozen.P3: GRP_POS gains more than BASE_POS (its group weight is not diluted to 1/p)
predictions_frozen.P4: every position variant lowers ProcessBench SLA
predictions_frozen.P5: the content share of the position gains is small (< 50%)

hard_stops: input hashes differ from the algorithm_decisions_v1 manifest
BASE or GRP replay of algorithm_decisions_v1 P0__BASE / P0__EQ_DSM > 1e-9
review: pre-run code review; red team of three after the run

amendments.after: fold-0 smoke (feasibility only) and the pre-run review
amendments.change_1_adoption_rule: adopt a position variant iff (a) its primary contrast (BASE_POS - BASE or GRP_POS - GRP) is Bonferroni above 0 on within-AUC on all four banks AND (b) the variant is above POS_ALONE (step index alone) on within-AUC with the 95% interval above 0 on all four banks (the bank channels still add beyond the prior); the ProcessBench change is stated beside. The same-length swap-null content difference is reported as DESCRIPTIVE only.
amendments.reason_1: the pre-run review showed that the frozen clause (content share > 0 on 3 of 4 banks) cannot be met by any position channel by construction: under same-length label swap the base score falls to its positional AUC, so adding the step index gains MORE under the null than on real labels (swap mean > observed on 8/8 primary contrasts in the smoke). The clause was a logic error, not a data-driven change.
amendments.change_2_wording: the direction of POS (a later step is riskier) is a DECLARED structural prior (error propagation), not a label-free finding; it is also consistent with earlier labelled results (step index 0.6617 on development). A label-free orientation diagnostic is logged: the sign of the Spearman correlation of POS with the BASE score on the fit rows. The DS filter can drop POS but not flip it.
amendments.change_3_cum_note: CUM is a function of the survivors, so its Dawid-Skene accuracy estimate measures agreement with its own source, not accuracy; reported as such.
amendments.change_4_statistics: content is reported as the difference observed - swap mean (the declared quantity); the ratio only when observed > 0.
